# Bundled dependencies

These sources are vendored and linked statically. Neither builds nor customer execution download dependencies.

| Dependency | Pinned version | Upstream | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| nlohmann/json | v3.11.3 | https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.11.3 | MIT; `json/LICENSE.MIT` |
| miniz | 3.0.2 | https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/tree/3.0.2 | MIT; `miniz/LICENSE` |

The upstream source files are unchanged. `miniz/miniz_export.h` is a local equivalent of the static-library export header normally generated by CMake. ZIP IO uses application-provided Win32 handle callbacks to support Unicode paths and the output boundary; miniz's file-opening helpers are not called.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` records the vendored files. These hashes pin the local distribution contents, not upstream authenticity. Dependency updates require review and rebuilding the behavioral tests.
